tools.name: list_genes
tools.description: List the genes in the DeepDNA knowledge base, with a one-line summary and category for each.

tools.name: lookup_gene
tools.description: Everything curated about one gene: function, key variants with rsIDs, metabolizer or function phenotypes, drug interactions, what a consumer genotyping array can and cannot tell you, and sources.

tools.name: lookup_variant
tools.description: One variant by dbSNP rsID: gene, star-allele or common name, alleles, functional effect, population frequency and sources.

tools.name: lookup_drug_gene
tools.description: Pharmacogenomic guidance for a gene, optionally for one drug: guideline (CPIC/DPWG), summary of the recommendation, phenotypes and sources. Omit drug to list every drug curated for that gene.

labels.name: check_medications
labels.description: Given a list of generic drug names, say which ones have a curated drug–gene record, with which genes and what each record rests on (a CPIC or DPWG guideline, a drug label, or the primary literature), and which are not covered. Needs no genotype.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_variant" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "One variant by dbSNP rsID: gene, star-allele or common name, alleles, functional effect, population frequency and sources." → after: "One variant by dbSNP rsID: gene, star-allele or common name, alleles, functional effect, population frequency and sources. Send the rsID only, never the user's genotype. A single variant is not a phenotype or metabolizer status."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_drug_gene" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Pharmacogenomic guidance for a gene, optionally for one drug: guideline (CPIC/DPWG), summary of the recommendation, phenotypes and sources. Omit drug to list every drug curated for that gene." → after: "Pharmacogenomic guidance for a gene, optionally for one drug: guideline (CPIC or DPWG, "drug label", or null when the record rests on the primary literature), summary of the recommendation, phenotypes and sources. Omit drug to list every drug curated for that gene."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
